_comment: Fixed universe for the DTA (Diversified Trend Allocator) core. 5 equal-weight risk sleeves + an ultra-short T-bill harbor for risk-off capital. A small momentum 'satellite' (state/watchlist.txt) can be enabled later via dta_config.json once the core has proven itself on paper. Edit deliberately — this is the whole investable universe of the core.

harbor.role: Ultra-short T-bills (~0 duration). Risk-off capital parks here and earns the bill rate instead of sitting idle. Allocated waterfall-style (fill SGOV first, then spill into the next) so no single holding ever needs to exceed the 25% position cap; five names give capacity for a ~100% risk-off without breaching it.
